projection_definitions.physical: Same templates with dVh=sqrt(deth)dOmega/Href³. The joint2x2Gram control retains X2X4 and reports its fit residual.
projection_definitions.quadrature: sqrt(a²+(p/omega)²)/Aneck: phase-rotation-invariant for that instantaneous oscillator convention, NOT a conserved coupled-parent amplitude.
projection_definitions.physical_frequency: Frozen Rayleigh quotientomega²=integral(|DX1|h²+mu(s)²X1²)dVh/integralX1²dVh; X1 is not asserted to be an actual evolving eigenmode.
projection_definitions.maximum: Passive actualDOP853polynomial evaluation, numerical maximization. Instantaneous physical crests all checked. No certified continuum-in-time error bound.

interface_definitions.F: X1=0 fixed timelike tube; no assumption carrierchi is odd under X1alone
interface_definitions.U: Future Eulerian normal projected tangent to F0 and normalized; orthogonal to its S2 cuts.
interface_definitions.traces: win=(Uphi-nBphi)/2,wout=(Uphi+nBphi)/2; j=win²-wout²=-Uphi*nBphi, separately for BOTH canonical fields.
interface_definitions.support: Actual j_total>0 labels local inward support; no field/trace deleted, no incoming-only initial state created.
interface_definitions.area_integral: Integral j_B dA on the GHleaf: area integral of local tube-proper-unit flux, NOT dE/dreferenceobserver_tau.
interface_definitions.coordinate_measure: P_GH=integral N_B*j_B*dA,N_B=1/U_B^0; also reported with positive/negative parts. No global Killing energy or anchor-clock energy derivative is asserted.
interface_definitions.exact_symmetry: Proper paired flip exchanges F±. Uchi is odd/nBchi even; US is even/nBS odd. Each j changes sign: global net cancels without pointwise flux vanishing.
interface_definitions.standing_field: Incoming/outgoing derivative RMS is dominated by massive normal-momentum oscillation. Large/equal traces are not evidence of a one-way propagating pulse.
